title: BMP signaling in the intestinal epithelium drives a critical feedback loop to restrain IL-13-driven tuft cell hyperplasia.
authors: Lindholm, Havard T; Parmar, Naveen; Drurey, Claire; Campillo Poveda, Marta; Vornewald, Pia M; Ostrop, Jenny; Diez-Sanchez, Alberto; Maizels, Rick M; Oudhoff, Menno J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肠道上皮中BMP信号对IL-13驱动的簇细胞增生的负反馈调控，属于免疫与细胞生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The intestinal tract is a common site for various types of infections including viruses, bacteria, and helminths, each requiring specific modes of immune defense. The intestinal epithelium has a pivotal role in both immune initiation and effector stages, which are coordinated by lymphocyte cytokines such as IFNgamma, IL-13, and IL-22. Here, we studied intestinal epithelial immune responses using organoid image analysis based on a convolutional neural network, transcriptomic analysis, and in vivo infection models. We found that IL-13 and IL-22 both induce genes associated with goblet cells, but the resulting goblet cell phenotypes are dichotomous. Moreover, only IL-13-driven goblet cells are associated with classical NOTCH signaling. We further showed that IL-13 induces the bone morphogenetic protein (BMP) pathway, which acts in a negative feedback loop on immune type 2-driven tuft cell hyperplasia. This is associated with inhibiting Sox4 expression to putatively limit the tuft cell progenitor population. Blocking ALK2, a BMP receptor, with the inhibitor dorsomorphin homolog 1 (DMH1) interrupted the feedback loop, resulting in greater tuft cell numbers both in vitro and in vivo after infection with Nippostrongylus brasiliensis. Together, this investigation of cytokine effector responses revealed an unexpected and critical role for the BMP pathway in regulating type 2 immunity, which can be exploited to tailor epithelial immune responses.
abstract_zh: 肠道是多种类型感染的常见部位，包括病毒、细菌和蠕虫，每种感染都需要特定的免疫防御模式。肠道上皮在免疫启动和效应阶段均发挥关键作用，这些过程由淋巴细胞细胞因子（如IFNgamma、IL-13和IL-22）协调。在此，我们利用基于卷积神经网络的类器官图像分析、转录组学分析和体内感染模型，研究了肠道上皮免疫反应。我们发现IL-13和IL-22均诱导与杯状细胞相关的基因表达，但由此产生的杯状细胞表型是二分性的。此外，仅IL-13驱动的杯状细胞与经典NOTCH信号传导相关。我们进一步表明，IL-13诱导骨形态发生蛋白（bone morphogenetic protein, BMP）通路，该通路在2型免疫驱动的簇细胞增生中发挥负反馈环作用。这与抑制Sox4表达相关，可能限制簇细胞祖细胞群体。用抑制剂dorsomorphin homolog 1（DMH1）阻断BMP受体ALK2，可中断该反馈环，在体外和体内感染巴西日圆线虫（Nippostrongylus brasiliensis）后均导致簇细胞数量增加。综合来看，这项对细胞因子效应反应的研究揭示了BMP通路在调节2型免疫中一个意外且关键的作用，该作用可被利用以定制上皮免疫反应。
